title: BC G306: Recreational Vehicles
officialText:
G306.1 Placement prohibited.

The placement of recreational vehicles shall not be authorized in coastal high-hazard areas or in floodways.

G306.2 Temporary placement in A-Zones.

Recreational vehicles in A-Zones shall be fully licensed and ready for highway use, and shall be placed on a site for less than 180 consecutive days.

G306.3 Permanent placement.

Recreational vehicles in A-Zones that are not fully licensed and ready for highway use, or that are to be placed on a site for 180 or more consecutive days, shall meet the requirements of Section G305 for manufactured homes.
